row.evidence: Sana's pricing page shows a single Enterprise plan with "Custom pricing" that includes "Domain verification, SAML-based SSO, and SCIM".
row.notes: Quote-only: Sana Agents (the product sold as "Sana") publishes one Enterprise plan with custom pricing that lists SAML SSO and SCIM; Sana Learn (the LMS) is also custom-priced, with plans starting at 300 users. Both products document SCIM 2.0 and require SAML SSO first. Sana Agents SCIM uses a bearer token generated per SAML configuration; Sana Learn SCIM uses an API client (Basic auth for Okta) or a SCIM token valid one year (Entra), base https://DOMAIN.sana.ai/scim/v2. Okta and Entra are set up as custom/non-gallery apps; no Okta OIN or Entra gallery app was found. Sana Learn also has a REST user API (users, groups, invites, roles, deactivate/reactivate) and vendor-run HR/Google Workspace sync; Sana Agents only exposes a public Chat API. Sana Labs is now part of Workday.

plans.name: Sana Agents Enterprise
plans.notes: The only plan on the Sana Agents pricing page.

plans.name: Sana Learn
plans.price_text: Custom pricing; plans start at 300 users; price based on 3-year contract
plans.notes: Single all-in-one plan; SCIM is documented in the Sana Learn help centre but not named on the pricing page.

scim.notes: Sana Agents shows its SCIM base URL per SAML configuration in Workspace settings; the base URL pattern is from the Sana Learn guide.

auth.token_source: Sana Agents: Settings > Workspace settings > General > Sign in methods > SAML SSO configuration > SCIM > Generate token. Sana Learn: Settings > API (API client) and Generate new SCIM token.
auth.token_expiry: 1 year (Sana Learn SCIM token); Sana Agents not stated
auth.notes: Sana Learn's Okta setup uses Basic auth with the API client ID and secret; its Entra setup uses the SCIM bearer token.

operations.notes: Sana Learn: 'Push User Activation / Deactivation' and 'Push Groups'. Sana Agents: users and groups sync; Okta setup enables Create, Update and Deactivate.

deprovision.data_retained: Sana Learn: deactivated (paused) users lose access but their data is kept in case they are reactivated.

custom.how: Custom attributes agreed with the Sana representative, all String type, under the namespace urn:sanalabs:scim:schemas:CustomAttributes (Okta guide) or urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:SanaLabs:2.0:CustomAttributes (Entra guide).

attributes.notes: Attribute list is from the Sana Learn SCIM guide, which files all of them under the enterprise extension; Sana Agents docs do not list attributes beyond userName as identifier.

roles.how: Not documented for SCIM. Sana Agents can set the workspace role (viewer, editor, owner) through a SAML 'role' assertion on login; otherwise roles are managed in the product.

limitations.text: Sana Agents SCIM needs Domain Control Validation for each synced user's email domain and a non-legacy SAML SSO configuration.
Sana Learn SCIM is one-way: Sana receives updates from the IdP and does not push back.

user_api.notes: This is the Sana Learn API. Sana Agents' public developer docs list only a Chat API. Each Sana product has a single custom-priced plan, so the API is not gated above a cheaper tier.

endpoints.purpose: List all groups for a user
List all users in a group
Delete a user from a group

limitations.text: Sana Agents' developer docs list only the Chat API as publicly available; no user-management API is documented for Sana Agents.

okta.notes: Both Sana guides set Okta up as a custom SAML app (Create App Integration / 'internal app'), then enable SCIM on it. No OIN listing found (okta.com/integrations/sana*/ return 404).

entra.notes: Sana Agents guide uses a Non-gallery enterprise app; no Entra Learn tutorial found (sana-tutorial / sana-provisioning-tutorial 404).

google.notes: Sana Learn runs its own Google Workspace user sync through a Google Cloud service account.

onelogin.notes: Sana Learn lists OneLogin among SCIM-compatible IdPs it supports; no OneLogin-specific SCIM steps are published.

jumpcloud.notes: Sana Learn lists JumpCloud among SCIM-compatible IdPs it supports; no JumpCloud-specific SCIM steps are published.

fallbacks.other_sync: Sana Learn: vendor-run hourly HR-system sync (HiBob, Personio, BambooHR, Google Workspace, SuccessFactors, Workday, Salesforce and others) built on the Sana Open API.
